topic: Joy Boy's broken promise to Fish-Man Island over Noah still hasn't been resolved eight hundred years later
title: Joy Boy Broke A Promise Nobody's Ever Finished
description: Eight hundred years ago, Joy Boy made a deal with Fish-Man Island involving a colossal ship called Noah, then broke his end of it. Fish-Man Island is still waiting. From the full story: The Void Century: Everything Joy Boy Left Behind.
comment: Will Fish-Man Island's wait for Noah ever actually pay off, or was it always one-sided? Pick one.

lines.text: Joy Boy made one promise eight hundred years ago that still isn't finished.

shot.fallback: silhouetted ancient figure making a solemn vow underwater

lines.text: He struck a deal with Fish-Man Island, involving a colossal ship called Noah.

shot.fallback: massive ancient ship being pulled by sea creatures

lines.text: Then, for reasons nobody's ever explained, he simply failed to keep his end of it.

shot.fallback: silhouetted figure turning away from an unfinished task

lines.text: He wrote an apology straight onto a Poneglyph, promising someone else would finish what he started.

shot.search: Joy Boy apology Poneglyph Sea Forest
shot.fallback: ancient hand carving an apology into underwater stone

lines.text: Fish-Man Island has spent the next eight hundred years quietly guarding that ship, just waiting.

shot.fallback: underwater kingdom guarding an ancient ship for generations

lines.text: It almost ends for good during the Fish-Man Island arc, when Luffy is asked to destroy Noah himself.

shot.search: Luffy asked destroy Noah Fish-Man Island
shot.fallback: young pirate facing a difficult choice over an ancient ship

lines.text: A group of Sea Kings catch the ship just in time, and carry it off to be repaired instead.

shot.fallback: sea creatures carrying a damaged ship to safety

lines.text: Not even Vegapunk knows exactly when this appointed time is actually supposed to arrive.

shot.fallback: ancient ship waiting silently in an underwater forest

lines.text: Because Joy Boy made one promise eight hundred years ago that still isn't finished...

shot.fallback: ancient figure's unfinished vow still waiting underwater
